limitations: The USB transfer-timeout count rises during a stop/start streaming cycle (24 vs 8); no data loss or dropped frame was observed in the 22.8 s pause run.
Optical darkness is not verified; readback only.
root_cause: WizardController.resume (persisted-session API) shadowed the pause-resume method of the same name. The GUI reported 'Resumed' but the controller stayed paused; the fix adds unpause() and a regression test.
